comments.text: I don't have a way to charge at home. I seriously considered it last year but I live in a super charging desert. The closest one to me is 15 miles away and everytime I go to that shopping block it's ALWAYS packed. I don't go out very often aside from going to work so having to sit and wait for the car to charge would be highly inconvenient. Even if I could charge at home, my electric bill would probably double or even tripple. Right now I pay about 50 bucks a month on gas. I think if I include the cost of the Tesla, the high insurance, etc. it's not worth it. You need a lot of disposable income to own a tesla
